title: Broccoli Salad
ingredients: 1 head broccoli (maybe parboiled, and well dried)
8 ounces sharp Cheddar, cut into very small chunks
Salt and freshly ground black pepper
toasted almonds for additional crunch, optional
directions: Trim off the large leaves from the broccoli stem. Remove the tough stalk at the end and wash broccoli head thoroughly. Cut the head into flowerets and the stem into bite-size pieces. Optionally, parboil for 60 seconds or steam quickly and dry thoroughly.

Place in a large bowl. Add the crumbled bacon, onion, raisins if using, and cheese. In a small bowl, combine the remaining dressing ingredients, stirring well. Add to broccoli mixture and toss gently.
